sara: FYI Legal escalated a retention-exception request from an EU customer. They want us to retain a scoped set of transcripts + derived embeddings for 13 months under a contract clause. Theywant a signed exception template and the minimal tech controls before signing.

ajay: Scope? full text or redacted? where are embeddings stored (S3 + vector DB?) and which KMS key?

sara: They said full transcripts + embeddings, ~18k rows. Storage target: eu S3 bucket. KMS: arn:aws:kms:eu:123456:key/priv-emb-v3. Vector DB is a managed instance in eu-west-1.

marta: From privacy POV: require documented lawful basis or DPO sign-off, strict RBAC for any auditor access, TTL on embeddings, and a provision that they must provide provenance mapping for any derived vectors so we can satisfy DSAR erasures.

lena: Infra note: we can carve a dedicated bucket/prefix and create an IAM role with scoped access. The pain point is ensuring erasure propagation to the vector DB if they later request deletion. We need provenance ids on the embeddings that link back to source transcript IDs.

ajay: Security items: 1) KMS key policy limited to exact service principals and security-admins. 2) Enable CloudTrail and KMS CloudWatch logs forwarded to the immutable audit cluster. 3) Add an explicit deny for any GetObject when object tag erase=true.

sara: Legal also asked to pause normal minimization purge for this cohort until the exception expires. That's the ask we need to gate heavily.

marta: If we approve, gating conditions I insist on: - Contract + DPO email on record - Exception ticket with TTL tag on objects - JIT auditor role with timebound access logs - Quarterly revalidation (90d) - Prohibition on serving embeddings into any production model without reconsent

infra-bot: AUTO: exception-ticket TCKT-2026-778 created by sara. Attach contract PDF and DPO email.

lena: Also discovered during an audit: an old archival job once wrote a few backup parts without object tags. We fixed the job and re-tagged, but add to risk memo. No key material leaked.

ajay: small CloudTrail snippet I pulled (for record):

```
2026-04-02T08:03:12Z s3 PutObject acl=private bucket=customer-backups prefix=exceptions/2026-04-01/part-12
2026-04-02T08:03:13Z iam AttachRolePolicy role=automation-legacy policy=allow-s3-write
```

This was an orphaned automation; rotated creds and removed policy.

marta: Proposed approval checklist (send to Legal): 1) Signed contract + DPO email 2) Scoped S3 bucket + prefix 3) Dedicated KMS key policy with principal list 4) RBAC request template for audit role 5) Object tagging + automated TTL lifecycle 6) Erasure propagation plan for vector DB (provenance mapping required) 7) Immutable export of KMS decrypt events and S3 access logs 8) Quarterly revalidation and auto-expiry

sara: Legal wants a concrete RBAC template. Can someone paste a minimal policy snippet we can include?

ajay: Quick minimal IAM policy snippet for the audit role (for Legal review):

```
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-eu-exceptions/2026/tckt-778/*"],"Condition":{"StringEquals":{"s3:ExistingObjectTag/exception":"TCKT-2026-778"}}},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":["arn:aws:kms:eu:123456:key/priv-emb-v3"],"Condition":{"StringEquals":{"kms:RequestTag/exception":"TCKT-2026-778"}}}
  ]
}
```

ajay: Note: org-level explicit Deny if s3:ExistingObjectTag/erase=="true" will be enforced separately.

lena: Infra plan: 1) create bucket/prefix and apply bucket policy 2) create KMS key with narrow key policy 3) provision IAM role with a permission boundary 4) lifecycle rule for 13 months + 7d buffer to support deprovision 5) wire CloudTrail -> longterm-audit + udpate SIEM. I'll open a terraform PR.

marta: Edge-case: If embeddings in the vector DB don't have provenance mapping (no source_id), we cannot guarantee erasure. Legal must accept that and add a clause requiring provenance delivery or accept partial erasure limits.

sara: I'll tell Legal that exception approval requires provenance mapping for any derived artifacts and that we reserve the right to refuse exceptions where provenance is missing.

ajay: I'll draft a short risk memo covering the archive mis-tag vuln, what we fixed, and residual risk with mitigations (rotated creds, added CI check for object tagging, tightened KMS policy).

infra-bot: ACTION: assign lena to infra tasks and ajay to security review. Next update due in 72 hours.

sara: Thanks all. Goal: PR + policy + privacy addendum draft by EOD Friday so Legal can sign. I'll update ticket TCKT-2026-778 with notes and ping back here. :thumbsup:
